noise: Reuse capture.transform: source-audio-SHA seeded zero-mean Gaussian noise,20dB whole-waveform SNR; attenuate clean and noise together to peak.98 when needed; round PCM16 without clipping
paritySelection: Lexicographically first clip ID and longest sampleCount (ties lower clip ID) in fold0 innerFitRows for all-age and ages6–12; deduplicate, never select from validation
parityFailurePolicy: Stop before full noisy extraction; do not relax tolerances after observing outputs
featureDefinitions: Recompute full392 q8CTC log-softmax, forced canonical path, all13scalar values/windows and frozen fullprecision1024contextual pooling from each noisy waveform
publication: Fresh-only staged run; complete only after every planned row,clip,source,posterior and perclip matrix is audited; preserve failure artifacts, no silent resume
